## The heuristic

**An escalation without a named receiver is a complaint.**


_Why:_ Ownership that no person has accepted is not owned. A queue absorbs it, the clock keeps running, and everyone involved believes someone else is now handling it. The name is not bureaucracy — it is the only part of the mechanism that actually moves the work.
